articles.title: Clarity Act amendments would remake key parts of crypto bill but have doubtful future
articles.snippet: The U.S. crypto market structure bill is being targeted with dozens of amendments aiming to change or add to the text as its Senate hearing approaches.

articles.title: It’s time for clarity for America’s digital asset markets
articles.snippet: Recent polls have shown that registered voters want America to set the rules for global finance, reinforcing why the Senate must act now, explains Smith.

articles.title: Anthropic, OpenAI tokens plunge as AI firms say pre-IPO share transfers are invalid
articles.snippet: Tokens on Solana that claim to track the private-market valuations of Anthropic and OpenAI dropped sharply this week after both AI companies warned that the structures used to back the tokens may be invalid.

articles.title: US senators file over 100 amendments to crypto bill ahead of markup
articles.snippet: A leaked list shows Senate Banking Committee members have filed more than 100 amendments to a crypto bill, highlighting the issues likely to be debated at a markup on Thursday.

articles.title: Fake OpenAI Repo Hit #1 on Hugging Face—And Stole Passwords While It Trended
articles.snippet: A lookalike repository impersonating OpenAI's Privacy Filter model racked up 244,000 downloads in under 18 hours before Hugging Face pulled it.
